**[[Democratic Republic of the Congo|Congolese]] Foreign Minister [[Christophe Lutundula]] announces that the DRC has signed agreements for the complete withdrawal of the [[MONUSCO]] [[United Nations peacekeeping]] force. *[[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar civil war]]
**[[Operation 1027]]
***The [[Arakan Army]] assaults [[Pauktaw]], [[Rakhine State]], for a second time. The town has switched hands twice between the rebel group and the [[Tatmadaw|military]]. [https://www.irrawaddy.com/news/war-against-the-junta/arakan-army-in-fierce-fighting-to-retake-town-near-rakhine-capital-from-myanmar-junta.html (''The Irrawaddy'')]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Darfur campaign (2023–present)|Darfur campaign]]
***The [[Rapid Support Forces]] seize the [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] 20th Infantry Division headquarters in [[Ed Daein]], [[East Darfur]], effectively capturing the city. [https://sudantribune.com/article279589/ (''Sudan Tribune'')]
***At least 40 civilians are killed and more than 50 others are injured when Sudanese army [[warplane]]s bomb the vicinity of the 20th Infantry Division in East Darfur. [https://sudantribune.com/article279625/ (Sudan Tribune)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Cryptocurrency]] company [[Binance]] founder and [[CEO]] [[Changpeng Zhao]] pleads guilty to [[money laundering]] in the [[United States]]. The company will pay [[United States dollar|$]]4.3 billion in fines and Zhao will step down as CEO. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/us/us-authorities-set-unveil-settlement-with-binance-source-2023-11-21/ (Reuters)]

**Thirty-seven people are killed and several others are injured in a [[stampede]] during a [[military recruitment]] event at a stadium in [[Brazzaville]], [[Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/stampede-kills-37-during-army-recruitment-in-congo-capital-cf34db8c (AFP via ''Barron's'')]

*The bodies of four missing teenagers are found in an overturned car near [[Tremadog]], [[Gwynedd]], [[Wales]], [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/uk-wales-67484258 (BBC News)]
